channel.description: Latest articles from San Diego Community Newsgroup (sdnews.com)

item.title: Job-seekers frustrated with shifting hiring landscape now marred by AI
item.description: A sluggish labor market has swelled the ranks of the long-term unemployed.

item.title: La Jolla Village News: Feb. 27, 2026
item.description: La Jolla Village News covers the Mushroom House debacle as a graffiti-covered nuisance being cleaned but not becoming a lifeguard tower, harbor seal pupping season at Children's Pool, UC San Diego fencing joining pro league, sales rep Mike Fahey's retirement after 38 years, plus briefs on disbarred attorney, cancer fighter, live music, Leno event, Homeland Security funds, and girls water polo.

item.title: Eat Beat: From Dubai chocolate ganache to comfort food — San Diego’s tasty lineup
item.description: San Diego is serving up a week of indulgence, from rich chocolate drinks and ready-to-drink cocktails to hearty comfort foods and springtime bites.

item.title: Liberty Station’s naval past: Sailors, stories and the Silver Screen
item.description: Liberty Station’s naval past: sailors, USO shows, and Hollywood filming at the former Naval Training Center in San Diego.

item.title: US offers $10 million for capture of brothers said to lead Mexico’s Sinaloa cartel in Tijuana
item.description: The State Department is seeking Rene Arzate Garcia and his brother Alfonso Arzate Garcia in connection with drug crimes.

item.title: Fahey knew everyone, but ink has dried on advertising rep’s 38-year newspaper career
item.description: After decades of service, Mike Fahey, a high-profile presence selling newspaper and digital ads in Ocean Beach, Point Loma and La Jolla, has retired.

item.title: California snowpack grew after February storms, but remains below average
item.description: California's vital snowpack grew after February's storms, but is still only two-thirds of normal with one month left in the rainy season.

item.title: Oceanside Pop Warner won two national titles. But soaring costs are making it hard to find a home
item.description: The league serves children across five age levels, yet rising stadium fees have forced teams to rely on a single field that coaches call unsuitable.

item.title: Man extradited from Texas to face murder charge in Pacific Beach shooting
item.description: Felipe Villegas, 30, pleaded not guilty Friday in San Diego, in the 2022 killing of Mary Garcia, 65, on the shore in Pacific Beach.

item.title: Rep. Levin again opposes off-shore oil drilling as federal agency reveals plans for environmental study
item.description: "We won't tolerate the Trump Administration's intent to auction off California's coast for offshore drilling to the highest bidder," Levin said.
